articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos

articles.title: Budget carrier Norse Atlantic falls 81% after warning its finances are ‘critical’ amid soaring fuel costs
articles.description: The Norwegian low-cost carrier said its situation is dependent on securing financing for its short-term liquidity needs.

articles.title: French Senate rejects 100K euro crypto wallet disclosure requirement
articles.description: Senators also rejected stablecoin-swap and crypto exit-tax proposals, while the 2027 budget remains under parliamentary consideration.

articles.title: Stablecoin redemptions hit $12B in 30 days, echoing 2022 bear market
articles.description: Crypto research firm Kaiko said the cash-out was smaller than in 2022 and has slowed, with stablecoin supply down just 0.4% since Nov. 13.

articles.title: Ukraine tells Putin to ‘stop complaining’ over oil refinery attacks as Russia promises retaliation
articles.description: Ukraine’s foreign minister told Putin to end the war if he wants Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries, after Putin said retaliation was “inevitable.”

articles.title: EU seeks up to $55B for AI and quantum computing fund: Report
articles.description: Hackers already use AI to target crypto exchanges, while future quantum computers could break the cryptography that protects users’ funds.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slips back under $60,000 as HYPE leads altcoins lower
articles.description: HYPE fell 8% and SOL 5%, and one analyst said a recovery will need selling in stocks to ease first, with U.S. inflation data due before Thanksgiving.

articles.title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
articles.description: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.

articles.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
articles.description: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

articles.title: AI debt worries grow as Nvidia rebound masks Big Tech spending squeeze
articles.description: Big Tech could find it increasingly tough to secure funding from debt markets critical to the AI build-out, as lenders become pickier over corporate bonds.

articles.title: Just 10 accounts drove all of the XRP Ledger's trading growth last quarter

articles.title: Crypto talent will return ‘when AI implodes,’ Arthur Hayes says
articles.description: Maelstrom CIO Arthur Hayes expects the AI trade to face headwinds in the second half of 2027, with startup talent potentially returning to crypto afterward.

articles.title: Solana DEX Velocity halts trading over bug just months after relaunch
articles.description: Velocity relaunched in September as a rebuilt version of Drift Protocol, which was attacked by North Korean hackers in April.

articles.title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
articles.description: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.

articles.title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
articles.description: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.

articles.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
articles.description: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

articles.title: ‘Ready for any storm’: UAE minister optimistic on economy as IMF lifts forecast
articles.description: The UAE is optimistic about achieving 7%-8% economic growth next year, banking on a "different" economic model.

articles.title: China’s Xiamen Airlines to buy 50 Boeing jets in $7.4 billion deal
articles.description: Xiamen Airlines has agreed to purchase 50 Boeing 737-8 aircraft with a combined catalog price of around $7.4 billion.

articles.title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
articles.description: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.
